desc:
BATCHABLES BLUEBERRY MUFFIN MIX: Make small batches of blueberry muffins with Betty Crocker Batchables Blueberry Muffin Mix

CHOOSE THE AMOUNT: You can make anywhere from four to 12 muffins per batch

ADD MILK OR WATER: You can whip up delicious muffin mix in no time by simply adding milk or water

PERFECT FOR SNACKING: Bake up a small batch of muffins for a yummy breakfast snack with none leftover; Try other Betty Crocker Batchables for easy desserts, including chocolate chip cookies and fudge brownies

CONTAINS: 28 oz
features:
Key Features:

Flexible Batch Sizes

You can bake 4, 8, or 12 muffins at a time—great for portion control and reducing waste.

Large Resealable Tub (28 oz)

Keeps the mix fresh and allows for multiple uses without needing to bake everything at once.

Just Add Milk or Water

No eggs or oil required. The mix is designed for easy, no-fuss preparation.

Blueberry-Flavored Bits

Contains imitation blueberry pieces for a fruity flavor without real fruit.

No High-Fructose Corn Syrup

Sweetened without HFCS, and suitable for people looking for fewer artificial ingredients.

Kosher Certified

Meets kosher dietary requirements.

 

Benefits:

Bake What You Need

Make only as many muffins as you want—perfect for single servings or small families.

Quick & Convenient

Simple steps and short prep time make this ideal for busy mornings or spontaneous snacking.

Kid-Friendly & Beginner-Friendly

Easy enough for children or new bakers to make with minimal supervision.

Great for All Occasions

Works as breakfast, a snack, or a last-minute treat for guests.

Trusted Brand

Backed by Betty Crocker’s reputation for reliable and tasty baking mixes.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Artificially Flavored Blueberry Bits (dextrose, palm oil, corn flour, citric acid, artificial flavor, blue lake 2, red lake 40), Palm Oil, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Modified Corn Starch, Salt, Corn Starch, DATEM, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Artificial Flavor.
